Product:{\"sku\":\"7100122485\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
Raccoon City lies in ruins following an unprecedented biological disaster. Told from the perspective of Jill Valentine, a survivor of the special forces unit S.T.A.R.S., this is the story of the beginning and end of the Raccoon City Incident.

As the viral infection spreads through the city with every passing moment, “Nemesis,” the most fearsome assassin, stands in the way of Jill, who knows the dark secrets of Umbrella Corporation.

Can she escape this desperate threat? An extreme survival horror experience is reborn here from an over-the-shoulder perspective with cutting-edge technology and a deeper story.

This version includes:
- Resident Evil 3 Main Game
- Jill Costume: Classic
- Carlos Costume: Classic Hair
